claim.claim-text: What is Claimed is:

1. A method for detecting the presence of breast cancer cells in a patient comprising detecting the presence of a mRNA encoding a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample from the patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mRNA above the concentration for a healthy individual indicates the presence of breast cancer cells.
2. The method of claim 1 wherein the detecting step further comprises the steps of:

(a) providing a polynucleotide that specifically hybridizes to SEQ ID NO:15, (b) incubating the polynucleotide with the sample under conditions in which the polynucleotide can specifically hybridize with mRNA from breast neoplasia cells, and
(c) detecting the existence of a polynucleotide-mRNA hybridization complex.
3. The method of claim 2 wherein the polynucleotide comprises the complement of SEQ ID NO: 15 or a fragment thereof.
4. The method of claim 3 wherein the polynucleotide is a cDNA encoding a mammaglobin polypeptide consisting of the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO:2.
5. The method of claim 1 wherein the sample comprises lymph node tissue.
6. The method of claim 1 wherein the detecting step further comprises the steps of:

(a) producing a cDNA encoding the mammaglobin polypeptide from the mRNA using the reverse transcription method,
(b) providing two oligonucleotides which specifically hybridize to the cDNA to define a region of the cDNA to be amplified by the polymerase chain reaction method, wherein one of said oligonucleotides hybridizes under high stringency conditions to SEQ ID NO: 1 and the other oligonucleotide hybridizes under high stringency conditions to the complement of SEQ ID NO:l, c) amplifying the cDNA region by the polymerase chain reaction method using the two oligonucleotides as primers, and d) detecting the presence of the amplified cDNA region.
7. The method of claim 6 wherein the one of said two oligonucleotides comprises SEQ ID NO:4 and the other oligonucleotide comprises SEQ ID NO: 16.
8. The method of claim 6 wherein the sample comprises peripheral leukocytes.
9. The method of claim 1 wherein the detecting step further comprises the steps of:
(a) amplifying a target region in the mRNA encoding mammaglobin by the asymmetric gap ligase chain reaction, and b) detecting the presence of the amplified target region.

10. A kit for detecting the presence of breast neoplasia cells in a sample which comprises two oligonucleotides as primers for the polymerase chain reaction method packaged in a container, wherein said oligonucleotides specifically hybridize to a cDNA encoding SEQ ID NO:2 to define a region to be amplified.
11. The kit of claim 10 wherein one of said two oligonucleotides comprises SEQ ID NO:4 and the other comprises SEQ ID NO: 16.

12. A method for detecting the presence of breast cancer in a patient which comprises detecting the presence of a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample from the
patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mammaglobin polypeptide above the concentration for a healthy individual indicates the presence of breast cancer.

13. The method of claim 12 wherein the detecting step further comprises reacting with the mammaglobin polypeptide a purified antibody and detecting a binding of the mammaglobin polypeptide with the antibody, wherein said antibody is specific for a mammaglobin epitope comprising at least five amino acids of SEQ ID NO: 17.
14. The method of claim 13 , wherein said mammaglobin polypeptide comprises SEQ ID NO: 17.
15. The method of claim 14 wherein the purified antibody is a polyclonal antibody and the mammaglobin epitope comprises SEQ ID NO: 14.
16. The method of claim 14 wherein the purified antibody is a monoclonal antibody and the mammaglobin epitope comprises SEQ ID NO: 14.
17. The method of claim 13 wherein the sample comprises breast tumor tissue.

18. A kit for detecting the presence of breast cancer cells in a sample which comprises a purified antibody packaged in a container, wherein said antibody is specific for a mammaglobin epitope comprising at least five amino acids of SEQ ID NO:2 and wherein said antibody reacts with a mammaglobin polypeptide comprising SEQ ID NO: 17 or an allelic variant thereof.
19. The kit of claim 18 wherein the mammaglobin epitope comprises SEQ ID NO: 14.
20. A method for detecting the presence of endometrial cancer in a patient comprising detecting mammaglobin expression in a sample of endometrial tissue from the patient.

21. A method for detecting the presence of endometrial cancer cells in a patient comprising detecting the presence of a mRNA encoding a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample of endometrial tissue or associated lymphoid tissue from the patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mRNA above the concentration for endometrial tissue from a healthy individual indicates the presence of endometrial cancer cells.

22. A method for detecting the presence of endometrial cancer cells in a patient known to have or have had endometrial cancer comprising detecting the presence of a mRNA encoding a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample from the patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mRNA above the concentration for a healthy individual indicates the presence of endometrial cancer cells.

23. A method for detecting the presence of endometrial cancer in a patient comprising detecting the presence of a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample of endometrial tissue or associated lymphoid tissue from the patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mammaglobin polypeptide above the concentration for a healthy individual indicates the presence of endometrial cancer.

24. A method for detecting the presence of endometrial cancer in a patient known to have or have had endometrial cancer comprising detecting the presence of a mammaglobin polypeptide in a sample from the patient wherein an elevated concentration of said mammaglobind polypeptide above the concentration for a healthy individual indicates the presence of endometrial cancer.
